# Angela Fanelli

**DVM · MSc One Health · MSc Big Data & AI · ECVPH Diplomate in Population Medicine**

I am an epidemiologist specialized in animal and public health, with expertise in big data analytics and data-driven approaches to epidemiological research. My work focuses on integrating advanced statistical modelling, machine learning techniques, and large-scale data processing to strengthen disease early warning systems, improve risk assessment, and support evidence-based decision-making.
